description: Every arbitrary probability and parameter of the randomizer. Each entry is {"value": ..., "description": ...}; edit the value, keep the description up to date. Loaded and checked by core/game/data/tuning.py.

resource_to_root_mb.description: Megabytes the game's Resource heap (models, textures, maps; 47 MB on an Old 3DS, 52 on a New 3DS) gives to its root heap, which the mod's added code and data take from, so a full mod boots on an Old 3DS (game/executable/memory_split.py). Every built executable gets it.

old3ds_root_margin_kb.description: Kilobytes the Old 3DS root heap must keep free after the boot with the executable's extension at its largest; tests/game/executable/test_memory_split.py fails below it (the room the ported monsters' objects take in a hunt, and what the measure may have missed).

target_marker_priority.description: Aspect ratio option: the draw priority of the target marker (ui211_target, 0x13 in the game); above the item bar's 0x17, which the wider picture moves out to the corner, so the marker is never drawn under it (cheats/aspect_ratio.py MARKER_SITE). A whole number 0 to 255; the HUD's panels run 0x14 to 0x17.

talk_window_quest_modes.description: HUD size: the game modes (the game control's byte +0x2B, 0 to 31: 1 a quest, 5 its results, 2 the Gathering Hall) in which the talk windows shrink with the HUD; in every other mode (the villages, the Gathering Hall) they keep their full size (interface/hud/code_patch.py patch_talk_size).

coplanar.description: Felyne helms: a helm surface this close (skeleton unit) to a sample of the base's eyes or ears shares its depth with it and wins or loses pixels frame by frame; the converter sinks such a surface. The depth buffer settles about 0.001, the test checks 0.05.

parallel.description: Felyne helms: a surface near an eye or ear sample only shares its depth with it over an area when it faces the same way: the cosine of the angle between the two surfaces' normals is at least this (0.8 is about 37 degrees). A surface that crosses an eye or an ear at a steeper angle meets it along a line and is left alone.

extra_sinks.description: Felyne helms: the depths (same unit), tried in this order, by which a surface that lies within 'coplanar' of the eyes or ears is moved behind its front; the first that clears every sample is kept.

head_lifts.description: Felyne helms that show the base head's skin: the depths (same unit), tried in this order, by which a surface of the helm that hugs the head (within 'coplanar') is moved in front of its own surface so it stops sharing its depth with the head; the first that clears every sample is kept, none: the one that left the fewest. Each step swells the mesh a little: a longer list clears more helms and bends their hair more.
